subject: Calgary Landscape Solutions job tracking
body:
Hi Kyle and Chelsea,

I read that Calgary Landscape Solutions started as a small husband and wife team, and that you handle hydroseeding, sod, fences and grading. Quick question: how do you track quote requests and scheduled jobs today?

I'm Aldo — I run Arctos, a small Calgary studio that builds intake forms, job tracking and reporting around how a shop already works. Recently: a case-intake website for True North Kromes, a dental lab that 3D-prints cobalt-chrome frameworks, so labs can submit work directly instead of by phone and email.

If tracking quotes and scheduling takes more of your week than it should, I'm happy to look at how it runs today and tell you honestly whether anything is worth changing. No cost — just reply.
